info.title: Genie Ops Center API
info.description: The composed RPC contract as OpenAPI: core's agent, audit, branding, categories, groups, modules, people, roles and settings areas, then every module in packages/modules in id order. Generated by tools/generate-openapi.ts and checked in, so every API change shows up in review; do not edit by hand (ADR 0011, decision 4). Responses declared with z.custom are unconstrained.
